contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::endSale(): Real {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentSale.Amount = self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->sumBy(s: SalesLineItem|s.Subamount) and
		self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		result = self.CurrentSale.Amount and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = self.CurrentSale.IsComplete@pre
}
